speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia

The X-ray showing dilated bowel with a lack of gas in the rectum, combined with bilious vomiting and a tender, distended abdomen, strongly indicates a blockage in the upper intestine. Since the ultrasound was normal, this points toward a specific congenital defect rather than an intussusception or volvulus. I need you to confirm if the baby has ever passed meconium in the first 48 hours of life, as this is a key differentiator for small bowel obstructions. Also, please check if there are any signs of jaundice or a specific gap in the mouth you might have noticed at birth.
